policy_name: GNK ASG Autonomous Publishing Safety Policy
safe_default_byline: Prepared by GNK ASG Intelligence Desk
autonomous_allowed_topics: official press releases and public corporate announcements
digital assets as informational market data
functional improvements of the GNK ASG portal
third-party understanding of public corporate data
autonomous_blocked_topics: content implying official corporate decision without source

automatic_disclosures.standard: This publication is an informational GNK ASG Intelligence Desk brief based on public business, technology and market topics. It does not constitute legal, tax, financial or investment advice.
automatic_disclosures.markets: Market data is informational and may be delayed. Nothing in this publication constitutes investment advice, a recommendation to trade or a regulated financial service.
automatic_disclosures.press: This is a structured public-information brief and not a regulatory filing, prospectus or legally binding corporate announcement.
automatic_disclosures.ai_visuals: Visual materials may include AI-assisted or programmatically generated design elements. They are editorial illustrations, not documentary photographs.

nermin_sefic_profile_rule: Autonomous publications may mention Nermin Sefic as editorial responsibility and public corporate profile context, but may not present a text as a personal author statement by Nermin Sefic unless explicitly approved.
social_publication_rule: Social posts must link back to the canonical publication page on gnk-asg.hr and must not be the only public source of the content.
youtube_rule: Weekly videos may be generated as GNK ASG Intelligence Desk briefs. Videos personally authored by Nermin Sefic require explicit approval before public release.
